shared_elements: incised/carved linear signs or marks on a wall-like surface
vertical band or panel containing a column of repeated signs
justification: Both surfaces carry inscribed marks including a vertical column of repeated sign-like elements bordered by lines, and both include some crosshatch/lattice geometry, but this is a generic correspondence any tradition could produce. A shows only thin, sparse scratched linear signs and circles with no figures, whereas B is dominated by a large frontal standing human figure in elaborate headdress and costume rendered in dense relief, with glyph blocks flanking it — utterly different subject matter and depiction conventions.
